lines: Mind the tannery. The smell is honest, at least.
Give the tannery room. Leatherwork works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the tannery. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was just near the cauldron, trying to keep the day sensible.
Morning. Or afternoon. The work makes the hours blur if I let it.
Good to see you walking in calmly. That usually means nothing is on <gradient:gold:red><pulse>fire</pulse></gradient> yet.
If you need me, speak up. If you need gossip, speak quieter.
You caught me before the next little disaster. That is rare timing.
Hello. Try not to bring the whole village into this unless it is important.
I have a moment. Not a long one, but a real one.
Mind the dye. It has a longer memory than most people.
Hello. If the smell bothers you, that means it is working.
You caught me with a needle in hand and patience on trial.
Step around the stretched hides. They are busy becoming useful.
Good timing. I was just checking seams.
Keep your sleeves clear unless you want them permanently improved.
I can talk while the leather softens.
Welcome. Do not sit on anything that looks unfinished.
If you came about boots, show me the damage first.
The tannery is calm today. That is suspicious but welcome.
Hello there. Try not to disturb the straps in order.
I was measuring twice because mistakes here get expensive.
Stand where the floor is dry and tell me what you need.
Good to see you wearing things that still hold together.
I have thread, tools, and a little time.
